about: Where Movebank attributes go in DwC-DP, written by hand from references/recipes/tracking.md. Keys are MVB ids (crosswalks/movebank-attributes.json). An empty 'to' means the attribute decides something rather than filling a field.

MVB000200.label: timestamp
MVB000200.note: of the location event, in UTC as ISO 8601

MVB000034.label: Argos LC
MVB000034.note: the class in remarks; an uncertainty only by an agreed rule

MVB000118.label: GPS HDOP
MVB000118.note: HDOP is not a distance; an uncertainty only by an agreed rule

MVB000142.label: location error numerical
MVB000142.note: the sensor's own error estimate, if in metres

MVB000162.label: modelled
MVB000162.note: decides which rows become occurrences: modelled positions are estimates; ask

MVB000209.label: visible
MVB000209.note: decides which rows become occurrences: FALSE marks outliers; ask

MVB000011.label: algorithm marked outlier
MVB000011.note: decides which rows become occurrences (outliers); ask

MVB000156.label: manually marked outlier
MVB000156.note: decides which rows become occurrences (outliers); ask

MVB000133.label: import marked outlier
MVB000133.note: decides which rows become occurrences (outliers); ask

MVB000018.label: animal life stage
MVB000018.note: of the tag attachment: recorded for the start of the deployment

MVB000021.label: animal reproductive condition
MVB000021.note: of the tag attachment: recorded for the deployment

MVB000340.label: animal group ID
MVB000340.note: a trait of the animal without a field

MVB000013.label: animal death comments
MVB000013.note: only if it states a cause; otherwise organismRemarks

MVB000081.label: deploy on timestamp
MVB000081.note: start of the deployment interval, and the attachment event's date

MVB000052.label: attachment type
MVB000052.note: about the deployment, with the MVB IRI as assertionTypeIRI

MVB000086.label: duty cycle
MVB000086.note: about the deployment, with the MVB IRI as assertionTypeIRI

MVB000155.label: manipulation type
MVB000155.note: about the deployment, with the MVB IRI as assertionTypeIRI

MVB000188.label: tag readout method
MVB000188.note: about the deployment, with the MVB IRI as assertionTypeIRI

MVB000374.label: outlier comments
MVB000374.note: about the deployment, with the MVB IRI as assertionTypeIRI

MVB000181.label: tag ID
MVB000181.note: the tag, as an agent of type machine, with an event-agent-role on the deployment

MVB000182.label: tag local identifier
MVB000182.note: the tag, as an agent of type machine, with an event-agent-role on the deployment

MVB000183.label: tag manufacturer name
MVB000183.note: part of the tag's name, or agentRemarks

MVB000185.label: tag model
MVB000185.note: part of the tag's name, or agentRemarks

MVB000173.label: study name
MVB000173.note: the study event, and the package's title

MVB000170.label: sensor type
MVB000170.note: how the location was determined; one sensor per row

MVB000067.label: behavioural classification
MVB000067.note: if the data holder agrees it is the animal's behaviour

MVB000131.label: height above mean sea level
MVB000131.note: an altitude; ask which DwC-DP field and reference surface

MVB000130.label: height above ellipsoid
MVB000130.note: an altitude above the ellipsoid; ask which DwC-DP field and reference surface
